name: Corpse Fleet Junior Officer
source: Starfinder Guilt of the Grave World

items.name: Semi-Auto Pistol
items.description:
Upgrades: 1

This pistol automatically ejects used cartridges and loads new ammunition after every shot fired.

items.name: Tempweave
items.description:
Upgrades: 1

Tempweave suits are reinforced hooded garments woven with thermal fabric and venting wires, popularly worn for trips to humid climates like the jungles of Castrovel or Pulonis.

items.name: Datapad
items.description: These ubiquitous handheld computers incorporate a comm unit, microphone, speaker, camera, infosphere browser, and data storage. They can store thousands of hours of recordings, play games, and perform simple computing functions, such as time tracking and notifications, word processing, calculations, data processing, streaming media, and broadcasting emergency alerts from local governments. In most societies, commercial datapads are relatively flimsy, designed to rapidly wear out or fall behind on the latest features and updates to encourage the consumer to replace it with a newer model. In contrast, higher-end datapads are made to last and often include a sturdier chassis and extra functions.

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Rally the Troops
offensiveAbilities.description:
The officer issues an order for their allies to regroup. All Corpse Fleet allies within 120 feet of the officer can use a reaction to Stride up to their Speed. One Corpse Fleet ally who ends their movement adjacent to another Corpse Fleet ally gains 5 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 minute, or double that number of temporary Hit Points if they end their movement adjacent to the officer. The officer can't Rally the Troops again for 1d4 rounds.

Effect: Rally the Troops

offensiveAbilities.name: Shoot to Kill
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect The junior officer designates one target within 60 feet that they can see. That creature takes a –1 circumstance penalty to its AC against all ranged attacks made by members of the Corpse Fleet until the beginning of the Corpse Fleet junior officer's next turn.

Effect: Shoot to Kill

offensiveAbilities.name: Startling Charge
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements An enemy creature is within 30 feet of the junior officer

Effect The junior officer twists their face into a horrific grimace before advancing. The junior officer attempts an Intimidation check to Demoralize the target creature, then Strides directly toward that creature.
